name: Grilled Jerk Chicken with Coconut Rice & Mango-Bell Pepper Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups water
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lime
1 mango
1 red bell pepper
½ English cucumber
½ jalapeño pepper
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, zest lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices, then stir to combine the jerk marinade. (Reserve lime for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp salt
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp thyme, dried
¼ tsp cayenne pepper
⅛ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the pan heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season 2 chicken thighs with salt and pepper, place on a plate, and drizzle with oil. Add remaining chicken to the bowl with the jerk marinade and turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add chicken and grill (keeping the plain and jerk thighs separate) until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to separate plates and loosely cover each with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lime into a clean medium bowl.

Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Small dice half of the mango and add to the bowl with the lime juice. Thinly slice remaining mango and add to the plate with the plain chicken.
Trim, seed, and small dice half of the bell pepper. Add to the bowl. Slice remaining bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips, add to the plate with the plain chicken, and set aside.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl, along with salt and pepper, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ shallot
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Just before serving, fluff rice with a fork, add coconut, and stir to combine.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut plain chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. Divide chicken between plates, along with reserved mango, bell pepper, and a ½-cup of coconut rice.

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice, jerk chicken thighs, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
